name: p4_seizure_eeg
outcome_definition: Per-window (4-second, non-overlapping) EEG epoch overlapping an expert-annotated seizure interval from the CHB-MIT chb01 recordings. This is a window-level event-detection label, not an epilepsy diagnosis (spec: 'CHB-MIT seizure output is not an epilepsy diagnosis'). A single patient's three recording hours only; not a population-level model.
